messages:
sasha: Heads-up: found a tiny garden gnome behind the monitor tower. labeled 'do not move'. who installed him?
miguel: guilty. he came with my plant shipment. he has very strong opinions about sneaker swaps.
tara: sneaker swap? explain.
miguel: every month we swap one pair of lightly used office sneakers. gnome judges who's most deserving.
ben: this is both peak miguel and also possibly illegal.
sasha: sounds silly, but i'm in if the gnome is impartial. name ideas for the gnome?
tara: Judge Bean. or Sir Lace-a-lot.
miguel: Sir Lace-a-lot wins. robe pending.
ops-bot: Reminder: Office shoebox storage limited. Please label items.
sasha: rule proposal: sneakers must be clean, odor-free, and come with a small treat. gnome may veto.
ben: gnome veto power = scary but fair.
tara: can we have a non-sneaker prize? like a $10 coffee card if you're gracious enough to donate?
miguel: yes. good karma prize.
sasha: first swap ceremony Friday 4pm. bring a shoebox and a small note about why you're letting them go.
ben: will bring an explanatory haiku.
tara: merch idea: tiny paper crowns for winners.
miguel: //posts pic of gnome wearing a sticky note crown//
sasha: perfect. community-building level: medium. office-culture level: excellent.
ops-bot: :sparkles: "Sir Lace-a-lot" added to Office Lore by @miguel (channel: #random).
ben: RSVP: yes. will clean sneakers ASAP.
tara: same. also will vendor a tiny robe pattern for Sir Lace-a-lot.
miguel: proud to be gnome-keeper. will supervise swaps with dignity.
sasha: this is the most extremely reasonable thing we've done all week. see you Friday.
ben: may the best feet win. :athletic_shoe:
